sloka: शापितो ऽसि नरेन्द्रेण यत्त्वं सन्तापमागतः ।तद्ब्रूयाः सन्निधौ मह्यमहमाज्ञापयामि ते ।। ७.४७.९ ॥
transliteration: śāpito 'si narendreṇa yattvaṁ santāpamāgataḥ ।tadbrūyāḥ sannidhau mahyamahamājñāpayāmi te ।। 7.47.9 ॥

translations.english: You must tell me in my presence if you have been cursed by the king, which has caused you such distress, for I command you to do so.
